title: 계절이 바뀔 때: 단풍, 태풍, 미세먼지
objective: By the end, you can understand and use ten words about seasonal weather and air quality, such as 단풍, 미세먼지, 쌀쌀하다 and 선선하다, in short everyday sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday words Koreans use to talk about seasonal weather, from summer heat to autumn leaves and fine dust.

task.title: Use the season words
task.line: Read each sentence or situation and choose, write, or change a word from the word list.

words.meaning: autumn leaves (leaves that turn red and yellow)
words.example: 이번 주말에 단풍 보러 산에 갈까요?
words.exampleMeaning: Shall we go to the mountains this weekend to see the autumn leaves?
Lots of fallen leaves have piled up on the road, so it is slippery.

words.meaning: typhoon (a strong storm with heavy wind and rain)
words.exampleMeaning: When a typhoon comes, do not go outside.

words.example: 오늘 미세먼지가 나쁘니까 마스크를 쓰고 나가세요.
words.exampleMeaning: The fine dust is bad today, so wear a mask when you go out.

words.meaning: to be chilly (a little cold, not pleasant)
words.exampleMeaning: It is chilly in the mornings and evenings, so bring a light jacket.

words.meaning: to be cool and pleasant (of air or wind)
words.exampleMeaning: Now that it is September, the wind has become quite cool.

words.meaning: to be hot and humid, muggy (ㅂ irregular: 무더워요)
words.exampleMeaning: Drink water often in hot, muggy weather.
During the rainy season, I always carry an umbrella.

words.meaning: the gap between day and night temperatures
words.example: 요즘은 일교차가 커서 감기에 걸리기 쉬워요.
words.exampleMeaning: These days the gap between day and night temperatures is big, so it is easy to catch a cold.

words.meaning: a sudden shower (heavy rain that stops soon)
words.example: 소나기가 와서 가게 앞에서 잠깐 기다렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: A sudden shower came, so I waited for a moment in front of a shop.

exercises: Choose the better word: ① 바람이 시원해서 걷기 딱 좋아요. 날씨가 (쌀쌀해요 / 선선해요). ② 얇은 옷만 입고 나왔더니 좀 추워요. 날씨가 (쌀쌀해요 / 선선해요).
Fill in each blank with one word from the list: ① 가을에 나뭇잎이 빨갛고 노랗게 변한 것을 ____이라고 해요. ② 나무에서 떨어진 잎을 ____이라고 해요. ③ 여름에 비가 오랫동안 계속 오는 때를 ____라고 해요.
Which word from the list fits each situation?: ① 아침에는 5도인데 낮에는 20도까지 올라가요. ② 바람이 아주 세게 불고 비가 많이 와서 큰 나무가 흔들려요. ③ 맑은 날인데 갑자기 비가 쏟아지다가 금방 그쳤어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 하늘이 뿌옇고 목이 따가워요. 오늘 ____가 정말 심하네요.
Change the word in brackets using -어서 (because). Remember that ㅂ changes to 워: 어제는 너무 (무덥다) 에어컨을 하루 종일 켰어요.
answers: ① 단풍 ② 낙엽 ③ 장마
① 일교차 (일교차가 커요) ② 태풍 ③ 소나기
